purpose: Add Holy, Holy, Holy with source-traceable public-domain text, a public-domain playable SATB MIDI arrangement, and presentation-ready stanza text.
guardrails: Lyrics were transcribed line by line from the cited validated 1918 hymnal page without modernization or correction.
Reginald Heber's 1826 text and John B. Dykes's 1861 NICAEA tune are public domain.
The exact MIDI and machine-readable Mutopia license record are retained locally and verified by SHA-256.
The Mutopia record identifies the SATB setting as Public Domain.
No historical or modern performance recording is included or implied to be reusable.

entries.title: Holy, Holy, Holy
entries.text_source_edition: The Army and Navy Hymnal, 1918, hymn 4
entries.midi_setting_creator: Steve Dunlop for the Mutopia Project
entries.presentation_use: Four exact-source stanza slides and a title slide linked to KJV Scripture references.
entries.recording_scope: The in-app Web Audio playback is synthesized from the retained public-domain MIDI. No third-party performance recording is copied.
